title: PhyloSlicer: temporal slicing of phylogenies and cumulative-diversity rate analysis for macroecology in Python
description: Independent, vectorised Python implementation of slicing phylogenies to infer phylogenetic patterns over evolutionary time: a single (E, k) interval-intersection contribution matrix instead of per-slice tree copies, sparse-matrix PD/PE/PB indices, certified cumulative-diversity rate fitting with diagnostics, posterior-tree uncertainty, spatial adjacency helpers and a CLI. Cross-validated against treesliceR v1.1.0.

creators.name: Zichao Zeng
creators.affiliation: School of Life Sciences and Biotechnology, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai, China

notes: Source code: https://github.com/ZengZichao/PhyloSlicer (BSD-3-Clause). The methodological source of the slicing paradigm, treesliceR (Araujo et al. 2025, Ecography 2025:e07364, doi:10.1111/ecog.07364), should be cited alongside this package.

references.title: 'treesliceR': a package for slicing phylogenies and inferring phylogenetic patterns over evolutionary time
